one_line: The paper proposes and tests a numerical rating methodology for quantifying low-carbon achievement and greenhouse-gas/toxic emissions of enterprises within the ISO 50001 framework, applied primarily to the energy sector (thermal power plants, boiler houses, power generation facilities); no Corpus-B continuous-production sector is applied.
